integrity: The rank theorem is proved symbolically from the published multiplication. A packaged checker verifies the determinant and all twenty-five cofactor identities over the integer polynomial ring; no finite experiment is used as a substitute for the general proof.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to extension degree five and to the displayed Nagy–Zhou multiplication; no isotopy invariance of the commuting probability is claimed. Absolute literature novelty cannot be certified by finite search.
title: Trace stratifies commutants in the five-dimensional Nagy–Zhou semifields
